editorial.blurb: MEDI Kitchen + Cocktail delivers a lively, Saturday-night energy with excellent Mediterranean fare and cocktails that range from crowd-pleasing to genuinely inventive.
editorial.insiderTip: Arrive at off-peak hours if you prefer a leisurely pace—the 7:30 PM rush can stretch service times, but the staff remains attentive. Don't miss the Dubai Chocolate Old Fashioned, and ask your server (they're genuinely wonderful) for cocktail recommendations.
